Name: Better Stardew Valley
Author: EddieF612
Description:
[b]Better Stardew Valley (BSV)[/b] is designed around higher yields, stronger production and gradual automation. It supports English and Simplified Chinese, with dedicated optional integration for Automate and UI Info Suite 2 (UI2). The figures below describe the default settings in BSV 1.0.3. [b]1. Seed returns and fertilizer-based crop yields[/b] Each successful ordinary crop harvest has a 50% chance to return one matching seed. This is independent of the crop-yield bonus. Each successful harvest also receives one mutually exclusive yield roll:
[list]
[*]No quality fertilizer: 20% double yield, 5% triple yield. [/*]
[*]Basic Fertilizer: 30% double yield, 8% triple yield. [/*]
[*]Quality Fertilizer: 50% double yield, 15% triple yield. [/*]
[*]Deluxe Fertilizer: 75% double yield, 25% triple yield. At least double yield is guaranteed. [/*]
[/list]All remaining outcomes give the ordinary harvest. Bonuses preserve the original crop items' quality, color and metadata. Hand harvesting, scythe harvesting and Junimos are supported. Failed harvests receive no reward; any bonus that does not fit in the player's inventory drops on the ground. This feature covers ordinary crop harvesting. Forage pickups, fruit trees, tool destruction of giant crops, and byproducts such as sunflower seeds are outside its yield multiplier. 

[b]2. Expanded greenhouse and cellar[/b] The greenhouse planting area is four times the vanilla size, providing 480 planting tiles. The cellar's usable floor area is approximately doubled, giving you more room for casks and production layouts while retaining existing floor-item positions and entrance relationships. These features change the vanilla interiors. Check compatibility when using another mod that replaces the same greenhouse or cellar map. 

[b]3. Catch legendary fish again each year[/b] The original five legendary fish can each be successfully caught once per player, per game year. The allowance follows the in-game year rather than a rolling cooldown from the previous catch. Once a new year begins, you can catch them again whenever their catch conditions are met. Multiplayer players have independent records. Lv3 Fishing Machines interact with the corresponding player's annual legendary-fish allowance. 

[b]4. Upgradeable Fishing Machines[/b] The recipe unlocks at base Fishing level 5, including an unlock notice on the level-up screen. Crafting requires six Fiberglass Rods, 200 Wood, 10 Iron Bars and 10 Copper Bars. Rods used for crafting or upgrades must have their attachments removed and contain no enchantments or custom data. Each machine cycle lasts 24 in-game hours. Each consumed bait unit produces one catch check, with no empty-hook outcome: a check yields a fish or another eligible item. Normal Bait, Deluxe Bait and Specific Bait are supported; Deluxe Bait increases the share of fish results. Location-appropriate jellies can also be caught.
[list]
[*][b]Lv1:[/b] copper appearance and 36 inventory slots. Uses 350 bait for 350 checks per cycle. Fish catches have a 45% double-catch chance. Quality is 75% normal and 25% silver, with no gold or iridium fish and no treasure rewards. [/*]
[*][b]Lv2:[/b] gold appearance and 70 slots. Uses 450 bait for 450 checks. Fish catches have a 55% double-catch chance. Quality is 35% normal, 40% silver and 25% gold. Normal and advanced treasure reward chances are 6% and 3%. [/*]
[*][b]Lv3:[/b] iridium-inspired purple appearance and 70 slots. Uses 650 bait for 650 checks. Fish catches have mutually exclusive chances of 66% double, 20% triple and 14% ordinary yield. Quality is 80% iridium and 20% gold, with no normal or silver fish. The ordinary-item share is reduced, and eligible legendary fish can be caught. Normal and advanced treasure reward chances are 10% and 15%. [/*]
[/list]Challenge Bait is supported from Lv2 onward. It turns a fish result into three fish and stacks with machine critical catches: up to six fish at Lv2 or nine at Lv3. Legendary catches can also receive critical bonuses; one successful legendary catch still uses one annual allowance, even if that catch produces multiple fish. [b]Upgrades:[/b]
[list]
[*]After 50 completed cycles, place 20 Iron Bars and 10 Gold Bars inside the machine to automatically upgrade to Lv2. [/*]
[*]Complete another 50 cycles at Lv2, then supply 10 Iridium Bars, 20 Gold Bars, two Advanced Iridium Rods and two Iridium Rods to automatically upgrade to Lv3. [/*]
[/list]Treasure uses BSV's reward tables and adds the resulting items directly to the output. Fishing Machines also have an optional auto-trash setting for items such as Broken Glasses, Soggy Newspaper and Joja Cola, while retaining fish, jellies, algae, bait and upgrade materials. 

[b]5. Automatic Crab Catchers[/b] The recipe unlocks at base Fishing level 6. Crafting requires four Crab Pots, 10 Copper Bars and 10 Iron Bars. Trappers pay half the crafting cost. Crab Catchers use the local crab-pot aquatic pool, with their own catch rules, a 70-slot inventory and a 24-hour production cycle.
[list]
[*][b]Lv1:[/b] 150 catch checks per cycle, costing 150 bait or 75 for a Luremaster. Ordinary bait gives a 25% junk chance and normal-quality aquatic catches. Deluxe Bait reduces junk to 15% and gives 80% silver / 20% gold aquatic catches. Aquatic catches have a 20% critical double chance. [/*]
[*][b]Lv2:[/b] gold appearance, 350 checks per cycle, costing 350 bait or 175 for a Luremaster. Junk chance drops to 5%, and the aquatic critical chance rises to 55%. Ordinary bait gives silver-quality aquatic catches; Deluxe Bait gives 60% gold / 40% iridium. [/*]
[/list]After 50 completed cycles, place 20 Iron Bars and 20 Gold Bars inside and use the upgrade button to reach Lv2. Trappers need 10 of each. Crab Catcher upgrades require an explicit player action. The relevant permanent crabbing book bonus provides an additional 25% chance to double output and can stack with aquatic critical catches, producing up to four aquatic items from one check. Challenge Bait behaves as ordinary bait in this machine; it does not apply the Fishing Machine's triple-catch effect. Crab Catchers do not produce legendary fish, fishing treasure, jellies or per-catch Fishing XP. 

[b]6. Shared machine automation and presentation[/b] Both machines can:
[list]
[*]Restart automatically after a completed cycle when enough bait is available. [/*]
[*]Use internal bait first, then withdraw only the missing amount for the next complete cycle from nearby chests. [/*]
[*]Move completed output into nearby chests, trying another chest when one is full. [/*]
[*]Reach ordinary wooden chests, stone chests and Big Chests within three tiles of the nearest tile in the machine's actual 2×2 footprint, including diagonals. [/*]
[*]Export completed output and wait when the combined bait supply is insufficient, without first draining an unusable partial external supply. [/*]
[*]Preserve overflow until space becomes available, pausing the next cycle when necessary to protect undelivered output. [/*]
[/list]This shoreline chest system is built into BSV and does not require Automate. The machines share a copper-and-metal visual style, with dedicated item icons, held sprites, placement previews, floating and line/cable animations, and completion indicators. Crab Catchers lower their pots on steel cables; Fishing Machines extend or retract their lines according to their working state. Both support suitable outdoor and cave water placement, interaction from shore within three tiles, pickup and replacement. Production still requires an eligible local catch pool. Machines in temporary cave maps have a preservation and recovery mechanism; bsv_cave_recover can recover machines waiting for restoration. Completed-cycle progress belongs to the machine. If player A completes one cycle and player B completes another, the machine records two completed cycles. 

[b]7. Grape farming and winemaking[/b] Grapes can be grown outdoors in spring, summer and fall. They mature in 15 days and regrow every seven days, withering outdoors in winter. Grape Starters cost 1,200g. Processing grapes in a Keg produces BSV's custom Grape Wine, with a base selling price of 1,800g. Each batch has an independent 1/150 chance to produce the rare Blood of Jesus wine, with a base selling price of 30,000g. There is no pity or streak mechanic. Both wines have dedicated bottle artwork, support Cask aging, and use the applicable native quality and Artisan selling-price bonuses. Fermentation and aging integrate with the normal machine workflow. 

[b]8. Tea farming and processing[/b] Complete Caroline's sunroom tea event to unlock BSV's tea production, with event dialogue and a follow-up letter explaining the rules. Tea Saplings are purchased from Pierre in spring and summer for 400g each, replacing the vanilla sapling crafting recipe. Tea plants need 15 watered growth days to mature, then produce one Tea Leaf every two watered regrowth days. Growth pauses without water. Manual watering, sprinklers and outdoor rain are supported. Important seasonal rule: BSV tea plants grow only in spring and summer. They die in fall, even indoors or in the greenhouse.
[list]
[*]Tea Leaves have a base selling price of 80g. [/*]
[*]One Tea Leaf crafts A Cup of Green Tea: 32 Energy, 14 Health and an 80g base selling price. [/*]
[*]Five Tea Leaves in a Dehydrator produce one Tea Cake after two days, with a 750g base selling price. [/*]
[/list]A Cup of Green Tea and Tea Cake are separate custom items with their own artwork. Vanilla Green Tea remains available. 

[b]9. Golden Apples and Tenacity[/b] Combine one Apple and three Gold Bars in your own upgraded farmhouse kitchen to cook a Golden Apple. Cookout Kits cannot make it. A Golden Apple restores 38 Energy and 18 Health. You may eat one per day, gaining a single-use Tenacity effect: survive a lethal hit at 1 HP, become invincible for 1.5 seconds, and briefly turn golden. The protection is consumed when triggered. Unused protection expires at 2:00 AM. Dedicated item artwork, a buff icon and a trigger notification are included. 

[b]10. Horse calling, ownership and permanent speed[/b] Mounted movement speed is permanently increased by 20%, with no item, skill, weather or activation requirement. Horses also approach faster when called through BSV. Press H by default to call your own horse in supported locations. The horse follows a viable route toward you while retaining its actual identity, name and ownership. Players with multiple horses can choose which one to call. Features include individual naming and renaming, nearby name/owner labels, claiming unowned legacy horses, and multiplayer ownership handling. Other players cannot ride a horse that already belongs to someone else. The call key and related settings are configurable. If H conflicts with UI2, BSV attempts to use the fallback key J and shows a notification. 

[b]11. Permanent 100g coal[/b] Coal sold by Clint costs 100g each. The price stays at 100g in year two and beyond. [b]12. Automate and UI Info Suite 2 integration[/b] Both integrations are optional. BSV's core features work without either mod. [b]Automate:[/b]
[list]
[*]Connect Fishing Machines and Crab Catchers to an automation network for bait supply and output collection. [/*]
[*]Recognize the machines' physical footprints and provide connection support between water machines and shore storage. [/*]
[*]Support BSV tea harvesting, Tea Cake processing and custom grape wine production. [/*]
[*]Optionally supply upgrade materials to eligible Fishing Machines; Crab Catcher upgrades remain player-confirmed. [/*]
[*]Work alongside BSV's native three-tile chest system. [/*]
[/list][b]UI Info Suite 2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Show machine level, remaining time, completed cycles, upgrade progress, inventory usage and relevant status. [/*]
[*]Show tea growth, regrowth, watering and withered states. [/*]
[*]Adapt tea-sapling harvest information and handle horse-call hotkey conflicts. [/*]
[*]Retain UI2's own tooltip-visibility controls. [/*]
[/list]The current adapters are based on Automate 2.6.1 and UI Info Suite 2 2.3.7. All integration code is contained in BSV. Neither third-party mod is bundled, and their original files are not modified. 

[b]13. Languages, multiplayer and configuration[/b] English and Simplified Chinese are included. Chinese game language selects Simplified Chinese BSV text; every other game language selects English. Item names, descriptions, recipes, machine interfaces, event text and BSV-provided UI2 tooltips follow this rule. Machines support multiplayer interaction, with production and inventory changes handled by the host and progress stored per machine. The host and every player should install the same BSV version. Configuration covers seed-return settings, annual legendary fish, machine balance and animation, horse controls, and Automate/UI2 integration options. 

[b]14. Installation and feedback[/b] Current version: BSV 1.0.3. Requirements: Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. Quit the game, place the BetterStardewValley folder in Mods, and launch through SMAPI. When updating, preserve your own config.json, fishing-machine.json and crab-catcher.json. Do not install the standalone Fishing Machine alongside BSV's integrated version or leave duplicate BSV folders installed. For bug reports, please include your BSV version, SMAPI log, single-player or multiplayer mode, and clear reproduction steps. For machine issues, include the machine level, location, bait type, and whether Automate or UI2 is installed. 

[b]15. Author and AI-assisted development disclosure[/b] BSV's concepts, feature design, balancing decisions and in-game testing are directed by Eddie. A substantial portion of this mod's code was written by OpenAI Codex. Codex contributed to implementation, refactoring, bug fixes, compatibility work and test development. BSV is a personal mod project developed with extensive AI assistance. Thank you to the creators and communities behind Stardew Valley, SMAPI, Automate and UI Info Suite 2 for the foundations and tools that make this project possible.

[b]Better Stardew Valley（BSV）[/b] 是一个围绕种植、渔业、加工生产和日常便利功能制作的综合模组。从收获返种、肥料增产，到可升级的钓鱼机与捕蟹机，再到葡萄酿酒、茶叶加工、金苹果和马匹召唤，BSV 希望给玩家更多发展农场的方式。 本模组偏向更高产量、更强生产能力与逐步升级的自动化经营。当前支持简体中文和英文，并为 Automate、UI Info Suite 2（UI2）提供专门适配。 以下数值以 BSV 1.0.3 默认设置为准。 
[b]1. 收获返种与肥料增产[/b] 成功收获普通农田作物时，有50%概率额外获得1颗对应种子。种子奖励独立于作物增产判定。 每次成功收获，还会进行一次互斥的作物倍率判定：
[list]
[*]无品质肥料：20%双倍、5%三倍，其余为普通收获。 [/*]
[*]初级肥料：30%双倍、8%三倍。 [/*]
[*]高级肥料：50%双倍、15%三倍。 [/*]
[*]顶级肥料：75%双倍、25%三倍，必定至少双倍。 [/*]
[/list]增产保留原产物的品质、颜色和物品数据，支持手摘、镰刀和祝尼魔收获。收获失败不会发放奖励，背包装不下的奖励会掉落在地面。野外觅食、果树、巨型作物的工具破坏及向日葵种子等副产物不属于这项倍率奖励的范围。 

[b]2. 更大的温室和地窖[/b] 温室种植区扩大为原版的4倍，共480格种植土地。 地窖的可用地板面积扩大至约两倍，为木桶陈酿和生产布局提供更多空间。扩建保留原有地板上的物品位置和出入口关系。 这些功能会调整原版室内地图，与替换同一温室或地窖地图的其他模组搭配时，需要检查兼容性。 

[b]3. 每年重新挑战传说之鱼[/b] 原版五种鱼王改为每名玩家、每种鱼、每个游戏年可以成功捕获一次。 年度限额按游戏年份计算。进入新的一年后，只要满足相应捕获条件，就能再次挑战，无需从上一次捕获开始等待完整的一年。多人游戏中，各玩家独立记录；Lv3钓鱼机与对应玩家的年度鱼王限额联动。 

[b]4. 可升级钓鱼机[/b] 基础钓鱼等级达到5级时解锁配方，升级界面也会显示解锁提示。制作需要6根玻璃纤维鱼竿、200木材、10铁锭和10铜锭。用于制作或升级的鱼竿需要取下附件，且不能带附魔或自定义数据。 钓鱼机每轮工作24个游戏小时。每份消耗的鱼饵对应一次捕获判定，无空钩结果：判定后获得鱼类或其他有效产物。支持普通鱼饵、高级鱼饵和针对特定鱼种的鱼饵；高级鱼饵可提高鱼类产出占比。还可获取符合地点条件的凝胶。
[list]
[*][b]Lv1：[/b]铜色机身，36格背包。每轮350鱼饵、350次判断；45%概率双倍捕鱼。鱼类品质为75%普通、25%银星，不产生金星或铱星鱼，也没有宝藏奖励。 [/*]
[*][b]Lv2：[/b]黄金机身，70格背包。每轮450鱼饵、450次判断；55%概率双倍捕鱼。鱼类品质为35%普通、40%银星、25%金星。普通／高级宝藏奖励概率分别为6%／3%。 [/*]
[*][b]Lv3：[/b]铱矿风格的紫色机身，70格背包。每轮650鱼饵、650次判断；66%概率双倍、20%概率三倍，剩余14%为单份鱼类产出。鱼类品质为80%铱星、20%金星，不再出现普通或银星鱼；同时降低杂物占比，并允许捕获符合条件的鱼王。普通／高级宝藏奖励概率分别为10%／15%。 [/*]
[/list]Lv2起支持挑战鱼饵：一次鱼类结果变为3条，并可与暴击叠加。Lv2最高一次6条，Lv3最高一次9条。Lv3捕获鱼王时也可以触发暴击，一次成功捕获仍按一次年度限额记录。 

[b]升级条件：[/b]
[list]
[*]完成50轮后，在机器中放入20铁锭和10金锭，自动升级至Lv2。 [/*]
[*]在Lv2再完成50轮后，放入10铱锭、20金锭、2根高级铱金鱼竿和2根铱金鱼竿，自动升级至Lv3。 [/*]
[/list]宝藏使用BSV的奖励表，奖励物品直接计入产物。机器还提供可切换的自动清理垃圾功能，可清除破损眼镜、湿报纸、Joja可乐等杂物，同时保留鱼类、凝胶、藻类、鱼饵和升级材料。 

[b]5. 自动捕蟹机[/b] 基础钓鱼等级达到6级时解锁。制作需要4个蟹笼、10铜锭和10铁锭；捕猎者职业的制作材料减半。 捕蟹机使用当地蟹笼水产池，按所在水域捕获对应水产。它拥有独立的蟹笼生产规则、70格背包和24游戏小时工作周期。
[list]
[*][b]Lv1：[/b]每轮150次捕获，需要150鱼饵；诱饵大师只需75鱼饵。普通鱼饵的杂物率为25%，水产为普通品质。高级鱼饵将杂物率降至15%，水产品质为80%银星、20%金星。水产暴击率为20%。 [/*]
[*][b]Lv2：[/b]黄金版本，每轮350次捕获，需要350鱼饵；诱饵大师只需175鱼饵。杂物率降至5%，水产暴击率提升至55%。普通鱼饵产出银星水产；高级鱼饵产出60%金星、40%铱星水产。 [/*]
[/list]完成50轮后，可以在机器内放入20铁锭和20金锭，通过升级按钮升至Lv2；捕猎者只需各10个。捕蟹机升级需要玩家明确操作。 支持相关蟹笼技能书的25%额外双倍效果，可与水产暴击叠加，单次最高获得4份水产。挑战鱼饵在捕蟹机中按普通鱼饵处理，不提供钓鱼机的三倍效果。捕蟹机不产出鱼王、钓鱼宝藏或凝胶，也不提供每次捕获的钓鱼经验。 

[b]6. 两种机器共用的自动化与外观功能[/b] 钓鱼机和捕蟹机均支持：
[list]
[*]周期完成后自动检查鱼饵，充足时开启下一轮。 [/*]
[*]优先使用机器内部鱼饵，不足时从附近箱子补足下一轮缺口。 [/*]
[*]将已完成产物自动转移到周围箱子；一个箱子满了，会尝试其他箱子。 [/*]
[*]从机器实际2×2占格中最近的一格计算，最远连接三格内的普通木箱、石箱或大箱子，包含斜向距离。 [/*]
[*]内外鱼饵合计不足时，仍会出货并待命；不会先拿走不足以启动整轮的零散外部鱼饵。 [/*]
[*]存储空间不足时保留剩余产物，等待腾出空间后继续；必要时暂停下一轮，避免覆盖待交付产物。 [/*]
[/list]以上箱子通路是BSV自带功能，无需安装Automate。 两种机器使用统一的铜色／金属机械风格，包含独立物品图标、手持显示、放置预览、浮动和线缆动画，以及完成状态提示。捕蟹机拥有钢索与蟹笼下放动画；钓鱼机根据工作状态收放鱼线。 支持在符合条件的户外和洞穴水域放置，并支持岸边三格内交互、回收与重新放置。生产仍需要当地存在有效捕获池。临时洞穴地图中的机器另有保存与恢复机制，可通过bsv_cave_recover命令处理待恢复机器。 周期进度记录在机器本身。玩家A完成一轮、玩家B再完成一轮，会累计为这台机器完成两轮。 

[b]7. 葡萄种植与酿酒[/b] 葡萄可在春、夏、秋三个季节露天种植，15天成熟，之后每7天再收获一次；露天种植会在冬季枯萎。葡萄种子售价调整为1200g。 葡萄放入小桶后可制作BSV专属“葡萄酒”，基础售价1800g。每批有独立的1/150概率获得稀有酒“耶稣之血”，基础售价30000g，没有保底或连续失败补偿。 两种酒拥有专属瓶装贴图，均支持木桶陈酿，并沿用相应的品质与工匠职业售价加成。发酵和陈酿衔接原版机器流程。 

[b]8. 茶叶种植与加工[/b] 完成卡洛琳的茶室事件后，解锁新的茶叶经营方式，并通过事件对话与来信了解规则。 茶苗改为春夏季在皮埃尔处购买，每株400g，不再使用原版茶苗制作配方。茶树需要15个已浇水的生长日成熟，之后每2个已浇水的生长日收获1片茶叶；缺水会暂停生长，支持手动浇水、洒水器及户外雨水。 注意：BSV茶树只在春夏生长，秋季会枯死，即使种在室内或温室中也一样。
[list]
[*]茶叶基础售价80g。 [/*]
[*]1片茶叶可制作“一杯绿茶”，恢复32体力和14生命，基础售价80g。 [/*]
[*]5片茶叶放入烘干机，经过2天制成1份“茶饼”，基础售价750g。 [/*]
[/list]一杯绿茶和茶饼使用独立物品与贴图。原版绿茶仍然保留。 

[b]9. 金苹果与“坚韧”效果[/b] 使用1个苹果和3个金锭，在自己已升级农舍的厨房制作金苹果。野炊工具无法制作。 金苹果恢复38体力和18生命，每天最多食用1个，并提供一次“坚韧”保护：受到致命伤害时保留1点生命，获得1.5秒无敌时间，角色短暂变为金色。 保护触发后消耗；未触发的保护在凌晨2点失效。配有专属物品图标、状态图标和触发提示。 

[b]10. 马匹召唤、归属与永久加速[/b] 骑乘移动速度永久提升20%，无需道具、技能、天气或其他触发条件。BSV召唤马匹时的跑动速度也相应提高。 默认按H召唤自己的马匹。马匹会在允许召唤的地点沿可行路线跑向玩家，保留真实马匹身份、名称与归属；拥有多匹马时可以选择召唤对象。 支持独立命名与重命名、附近马匹名称／主人提示、旧存档无主马匹认领，以及多人游戏中的马匹归属管理。其他玩家不能骑走已有主人的马匹。 召唤按键和相关设置可调整。如果H与UI2快捷键冲突，BSV会尝试使用备用键J，并显示提示。 [b]11. 固定煤炭价格[/b] 克林特出售的煤炭永久为100g一个，第二年及以后不再涨价。 [b]12. Automate与UI Info Suite 2适配[/b] BSV包含针对这两个模组的可选适配；两者都不是BSV核心功能的必需依赖。 [b]Automate：[/b]
[list]
[*]将钓鱼机、捕蟹机接入自动化网络，处理鱼饵供应与产物提取。 [/*]
[*]识别机器的实际占格，并为水上机器与岸边存储提供连接支持。 [/*]
[*]支持BSV茶树收获、茶饼加工和专属葡萄酒流程。 [/*]
[*]可按配置为符合条件的钓鱼机补充升级材料；捕蟹机升级仍由玩家确认。 [/*]
[*]能与BSV自带三格箱子通路共同工作。 [/*]
[/list][b]UI Info Suite 2：[/b]
[list]
[*]显示机器等级、工作时间、已完成周期、升级进度、背包占用与相关状态。 [/*]
[*]显示茶树成长、再生、浇水和枯萎状态。 [/*]
[*]适配BSV茶苗的产物提示，并处理马匹召唤快捷键冲突。 [/*]
[*]保留UI2自己的提示显示开关。 [/*]
[/list]当前适配基于Automate 2.6.1与UI Info Suite 2 2.3.7。所有适配都在BSV中完成，安装包不包含这两个模组，也不修改它们的原始文件。

[b]13. 语言、多人游戏与设置[/b] 支持简体中文和英文。游戏语言设置为中文时，BSV游戏内文本显示为简体中文；选择其他语言时，BSV使用英文。物品名称、说明、配方、机器界面、事件文本和BSV提供的UI2提示遵循同一规则。 支持多人使用机器，生产与库存变更由主机处理，周期累计属于机器。房主和所有玩家需安装相同版本的BSV。 配置文件提供返种开关与概率、年度鱼王开关、机器平衡与动画、召唤按键，以及Automate／UI2适配等选项。 

[b]14. 安装与反馈[/b] 当前版本：BSV 1.0.3。 运行要求：Stardew Valley 1.6.15或更新版本、SMAPI 4.5.2或更新版本。 退出游戏，将BetterStardewValley文件夹放入Mods目录，通过SMAPI启动。更新时保留自己的config.json、fishing-machine.json和crab-catcher.json。请勿同时安装独立版Fishing Machine与BSV内置版本，也不要保留重复的BSV文件夹。 反馈问题时，请附上BSV版本、SMAPI日志、单人／多人模式，以及尽可能清楚的复现步骤。涉及机器时，也请说明等级、地点、鱼饵类型及是否安装Automate或UI2。 

[b]15. 作者与AI辅助开发说明[/b] BSV由Eddie负责功能创意、机制设计、平衡调整和游戏内测试。 本模组的大量代码由OpenAI Codex完成。Codex参与了功能实现、代码重构、错误修复、兼容性适配和测试编写。这是一个明确采用AI辅助开发的个人模组项目。 感谢Stardew Valley、SMAPI、Automate和UI Info Suite 2的作者及社区提供基础与工具。
